field.name: content
field.p: (Originally posted by KI6UGB on April 12, 2014)

Hello all, I've got another event coming up, this time the Human Race on May 10. This is another fun, easy, low-stress event. All but one position are HT-friendly. Radio operators are very important to this event, as the organizers have no other reliable communications system on the course.

ul.li: 4 water stations (3 HT-friendly, 1 requires external antenna)
2-4 bicycle units (fairly level, easy course mostly through Spring Lake Regional Park)

field.p: Also need 2-4 APRS trackers or APRS-integrated HTs, depending on how many bicycle units are available.
Meeting at 6:45am at Net Control, Herbert Slater Middle School, Santa Rosa. Done around noon.
Thanks and 73, Sutter KI6ZON, Human Race Communications Organizer

field.name: content
field.p: (Originally posted by NH7X on June 3, 2014)

It's time to sign up for the 2014 Mini-DX event, scheduled for August 15-17 at A.W. Way Park along the Mattole River in Humboldt County. Comfortable camping with running water, flush toilets, and showers, plus gourmet meals and radio activities.
Camping is $20/night, with food contributions of $20-$30/person - the club helps offset food expenses. A duty roster distributes meal-prep responsibilities.
Confirmed so far: Lisa & Fred AE6SF, Keith AG6CI, Dave W6IBC, Joy KI6ASJ, Jack K6ROW, Marianne & Steve KI6TUR, Darryl KI6MSP, Charlie KZ6T.

field.name: content
field.p: (Originally posted by NH7X on January 29, 2015)

Dear Fellow Contester: since you enjoy participating in shorter domestic SSB contests, we want to be sure you're aware of an exciting four hour event of this type coming up this Saturday, January 31st - the North American SSB Sprint! The NA SSB Sprint runs on 20m, 40m and 80m this Saturday afternoon/evening:

Time zones:
UTC: 00z-04z
AST: 8pm-12am
EST: 7pm-11pm
CST: 6pm-10pm
MST: 5pm-9pm
PST: 4pm-8pm
AKST: 3pm-7pm
HST: 2pm-6pm

ul.li: Four-hour duration, ideal for participants with limited availability
Categories for QRP, Low Power (100w), and High Power with separate awards
Individual entry or team registration (up to 5 members)
Unique QSY rule requiring a 5kHz minimum frequency change after CQ
Multiple award opportunities including t-shirts, plaques, certificates, and achievement recognition
Random drawing for door prizes from all submitted logs

field.p: ssbsprint.com has the contest rules, a multiplier checklist, logging software guidance, operating tips, and planned activity tracking.
73 and CU in the Sprint! NA SSB Sprint Committee, Contest Manager: Chris Tate, N6WM
